name: garcon-pstack
description: Lightweight, evidence-first engineering workflows for Codex and Garcon.

interface.longDescription: A small Codex-native workflow stack for investigation, design, fixes, review, and verification. It integrates cleanly with Garcon without adding hooks, transcript readers, or durable orchestration state.
defaultPrompt: Use garcon-mode to handle this task with evidence-first verification.
Use garcon-review to review this change for confirmed defects.
Use garcon-investigate to explain how this subsystem works.
